about: Familiar Radiante (familiar4) remade from the user's 1080p video (Attachments/Radiant Familiar/EmoteandFallBigCreature_moving_and_landing_462eae0d_1080p.mp4, 2026-11-12: "lets use this bigger version"; 24 fps, 1920 x 1080, one locked camera). The old set had a flaw on the visor and was an upscale; this one is the video's own pixels. Idle, hit, death and an emote for cutscenes come from this video; the old attack and walks stay until a video for them comes. Alta + 64 + 36 (the copies by tools/scripts/sprites/quality_copies.py). The frames are first values read off the video: the user judges.
